scope: Input-distribution stability, operational flags, runtime compatibility and CSV portability
stability_claim: The eleven retained inputs show small marginal distribution changes between these two extracts; their distributions are not identical.

metric_definitions.standardized_mean_difference: (Scoring mean - reference mean) / sqrt((reference sample variance + scoring sample variance)/2); signed and expressed in pooled standard deviations
metric_definitions.ks_statistic: Largest absolute empirical-CDF difference for one numeric feature; descriptive D only, without an independence-based p-value
metric_definitions.total_variation: Half the sum of absolute category-probability differences over the union of categories; ranges from 0 to 1

interpretation_limits: Rows are HCP-months and HCPs recur; these are descriptive row-weighted comparisons, not independent-sample significance tests.
No pass/fail threshold or claim of equivalent distributions is imposed.
Marginal similarity does not establish joint-distribution stability, stable individual HCP values, target calibration, data correctness or historical feature availability.
Cohort composition differs between periods; small marginal differences do not resolve the target-definition or as-of risks.
